class.name: JRPGTroopPage
class.brief_description: A battle event page of a troop.
class.description: Says when a troop's battle event may run and how often. A page with no condition enabled never runs. When several pages qualify at once, the lowest-numbered page runs.

method.name: has_any_condition
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one condition is enabled.

method.name: matches_turn
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param turn] is one of the turns A + B * X ([member turn_a], [member turn_b]). With B equal to 0, only turn A matches.

members.member: HP threshold in basis points of max HP for the actor condition.
If [code]true[/code], the page needs [member actor_id]'s HP at or below [member actor_hp_bp].
Actor checked by the actor HP condition.
What the page runs when its conditions are met in battle; [code]null[/code] for no commands. Its sub-resource id follows the page's, so database files stay stable.
HP threshold in basis points of max HP for the enemy condition.
If [code]true[/code], the page needs the troop member [member enemy_index]'s HP at or below [member enemy_hp_bp].
Troop member (0-based) checked by the enemy HP condition.
How often the page can run.
If [code]true[/code], the page needs switch [member switch_id] to be on.
Switch checked by the switch condition.
First turn of the turn condition.
Repeat interval of the turn condition.
If [code]true[/code], the page needs one of the turns A + B * X.
If [code]true[/code], the page runs at the end of a turn.

constants.constant: Runs at most once per battle.
Runs at most once per turn.
Runs again whenever its conditions hold. Without a switch to stop it, it can keep the battle from advancing.
